## Executive Summary
The code provides a static validation method that checks whether a Model contains required properties and required container types. It ensures the model meets specific constraints and throws a ConstraintViolationException if validation fails.

## Purpose & Responsibility
Purpose: To enforce that a Model includes specific required properties and container types.
Responsibility: To validate model constraints and raise exceptions on violation.
- Validates the presence of required properties in the Model.
- Validates the presence of required container types in the Model.
- Throws ConstraintViolationException when validation fails.

## Key Capabilities
- Validates required properties in a Model.
- Validates required container types in a Model.
- Throws ConstraintViolationException to signal validation failures.
